design_philosophy: Utilitarian, information-dense, and highly legible for iPad/field use. Serious federal construction cockpit. Avoids playfulness and glassmorphism. Leverages subtle depth and precise typography.

layout_and_spacing.philosophy: Dense and structured. Every pixel serves a purpose.
layout_and_spacing.grid: Control Room Grid (tight gaps: gap-4 or gap-6, dense data).
layout_and_spacing.table: Dense padding (p-2 or p-3), text-sm, border-b border-slate-200, hover:bg-slate-50
layout_and_spacing.sidebar: Fixed width (w-64), flex-col, overflow-y-auto, bg-slate-900 text-white
layout_and_spacing.topbar: Sticky top-0, h-14, border-b border-slate-200 bg-white z-40

buttons.primary: inline-flex items-center justify-center rounded-md text-sm font-medium transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-blue-600 bg-blue-600 text-white hover:bg-blue-700 h-9 px-4 py-2 shadow-sm
buttons.secondary: inline-flex items-center justify-center rounded-md text-sm font-medium transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-slate-400 border border-slate-200 bg-white hover:bg-slate-100 hover:text-slate-900 h-9 px-4 py-2

kpi_tiles.class: rounded-md border border-slate-200 bg-white p-4 shadow-sm transition-transform hover:-translate-y-0.5

status_pills.class: inline-flex items-center rounded-full border px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-semibold transition-colors focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-slate-400 focus:ring-offset-2

data_table.header: h-10 px-4 text-left align-middle font-medium text-slate-500

login_background.description: Steel construction structure for login background (apply bg-slate-900/80 overlay)

icons.usage: Use strokeWidth={1.5} for a cleaner, professional look.

testing.rule: All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case format.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the provided colors, avoiding arbitrary additions of purple, teal, or neon unless functionally necessary.
Implement dense data tables without excessive padding to optimize for iPad screens.
Use standard Tailwind CSS configuration without custom utility classes unless absolutely required.
Do NOT use glassmorphism on data screens. The top bar should have a solid or near-solid background.
Ensure all text meets at least AA WCAG accessibility standards against its background.
Add 'data-testid' to all buttons, links, inputs, and functional UI elements.
Use sans-serif for main UI elements, but utilize mono typography for tags, IDs, or RFIs to maintain that technical, data-centric feel.
Keep the application white/slate colored with blue primary actions and traffic light status colors to project a serious federal construction cockpit vibe.
